findings.state_evidence: Pause reports menu=true and active_rigs=0. Resume reports menu=false, worn, pickaxe_level=1, drill_level=0, active_rigs=1, native active with updates 5431 to 5443 and no motion errors, but times out on world_active=false. Surface set_active uses visible/process_mode/player.control_enabled and has no active property. Moss walk-exit position is unchanged at [872,408] across its recorded samples.
findings.uncertainty: The incorrect world_active observer is consistent with the timeout. Visible rendering and increasing updates alone do not prove resumed keyboard control.
findings.smallest_next_step: Review the already-planned keyboard movement supplement on the exact same PCK, requiring actual position change and release.

observed_pixels: All 20 original 1688x780 PNGs inspected through view_image; no image edits. DPR 2 gives the same 844x390 CSS view as the retained approved Worn evidence.

The native character retains the approved glossy black/gold helmet, green cloth, tan pack, brown boots and approximately 60 CSS-pixel scale. No confirmed viewport cut, detached limb or duplicate native body in these sampled poses.

Moss left exposes the overhead pick head above the helmet; Moss down remains inside the left frame. Endless poses expose the arms and raised pick without the previous achievement titles; ore still naturally overlaps portions of the lower silhouette, so hidden pixels are not certified.

Iron and Burrower each show a single legacy character with different tools; Worn outfit reentry clearly returns the native character with red cloth. Reported native rig counts are zero for iron/drill and one for Worn.

hub-ordinary.png visibly holds the Worn pickaxe near raster x480-585,y510-630, where the previous f898 capture held Deepcore. The state now agrees: Worn, pickaxe 1, drill 0, one active native rig. This corroborates the controller cache invalidation.
Surface and Rootwound retain complete visible native bodies in ordinary terrain. Rootwound stands near the right boundary, with its visible tool still inside the image. These are idle captures.

Pause renders the ordinary DEV14 menu with RETURN TO MINE and no gameplay character visible; native rig count is zero. The post-resume screenshot renders Surface again, but input verification remains pending.
reported_state: Four-point health decreases with earned-impact increments in all four Moss and all four Endless direction checks; held rush health 27676 to 27668 with cycle 0.468. These are telemetry observations, not still-derived hit claims.
Surface touch-release reports mining=false, impact=2 and health 357 to 358 as passive regeneration continues. The observer script awaited an earned impact and health decrease before touchEnd.
Console contains no runtime error lines. Fixture reports persistence_active=false; this visual review does not certify saved-file byte preservation.
resolved_prior_findings: f898 Hub stale Deepcore gear is corrected in pixels and state.
Achievement title occlusion from f898 is removed in these captures.
uncertainty: Still bracketing spans progressing swing phases and may cross a cycle boundary; no exact contact-frame assertion.
No continuous-motion, smoothness, FPS, performance score or physical-iPhone claim.
